overclaims: e4 explanation: "METR found substantially weaker performance than leading US models on some autonomous and AI research tasks." METR found R1 slightly above o1-preview on autonomy tasks and below other frontier models only on RE-Bench. Nothing in the source says "substantially".
checks.note: The rationale and limitations are accurate.
